hyperedges.label: Job Lifecycle: apply, convoke, confirm, photo, review, amount

nodes.label: Schedule Change Requires Re-convocation
nodes.rationale: Future active participations are withdrawn with a notice when programming changes; started days and history are preserved; simple notes do not remove confirmations.

nodes.label: Manual Convocation (no automatic ranking)
nodes.rationale: Management selects or summons people directly; there are no recommendations or automatic classification.

nodes.label: Fictitious Data Only Rule
nodes.rationale: Never insert real names or phone numbers; demo stores everything client-side without security.

nodes.label: localStorage Repository Adapter (copy-write, quota handling)
nodes.rationale: Demo adapter intended to be replaced by calls to a future API.

nodes.label: User Profiles (dono, gestor, midia, promotor, funcionario, prestador)
nodes.norm_label: user profiles (dono, gestor, midia, promotor, funcionario, prestador)

nodes.label: Retratus App (vagas de eventos e acoes)
nodes.norm_label: retratus app (vagas de eventos e acoes)

nodes.label: Claude Code + Codex Shared Repository Workflow
nodes.norm_label: claude code + codex shared repository workflow
nodes.rationale: Codex built the base and both agents edit the same repo, so always re-read files before changing; business rules live in domain.js and every new rule needs a test.

nodes.label: Demo Limits: No Backend or Secure Auth
nodes.norm_label: demo limits: no backend or secure auth
nodes.rationale: Browser holds the full base including values and base64 photos; profile checks demonstrate behavior but are not security; no cross-device concurrency.

nodes.label: Convocation Expiry and 30-day Photo Deletion
nodes.rationale: No real scheduler exists; expiry is reapplied on load, on change and when the clock advances; deletion keeps metadata and history.

nodes.label: Start/End Photo Records (JPG/PNG/WebP up to 1 MB)
nodes.norm_label: start/end photo records (jpg/png/webp up to 1 mb)

nodes.label: POLICY (timezone, Monday week, civil month, deadlines)
nodes.norm_label: policy (timezone, monday week, civil month, deadlines)

nodes.label: Pilot Proposal: Static Frontend + Supabase Free
nodes.norm_label: pilot proposal: static frontend + supabase free
nodes.rationale: Estimated ~960 MB of photos (16 people x 30 days x 2 x 1 MB) against a 1 GB cap, so compression, global quota and monitoring are required.
